name: Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter
storyline: The Grand High Wizard Council has mandated a “reduction in wizards” of the local area. A general reduction spell has been cast over the realm. The final step comes down to using Pew Pew Magic to personally disable each wizard’s protective aura. Your chosen wizard has been given the task of carrying out the order and so must travel to each location and "fire" the representative stationed there.
summary: It's Wizard VS Wizard in this isometric arcade battle blaster! Dominate a gauntlet of Best-of-5 duels across unique, destructible arenas that change with every match. Out-maneuver rivals with your chosen fighter's special moves to an eclectic electronic score by inflexi0n.
